title: dysoxylum alliarum
intro: Dysoxylum alliarum, commonly known as the Indian mastich tree, is a plant species native to India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Dysoxylum alliarum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Dysoxylum alliarum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
